title: Nosferatu, 1 dollar, Silent Film Classic
descriptionPlain: Description Nosferatu opens this exceptional series — a tribute to the classics of horror and German expressionism, where the image becomes a vessel of dread, unease, and mystery. F.W. Murnau’s 1922 film, considered one of the most important works in the history of cinema, continues to fascinate with its atmosphere and visual mastery. Count Orlok — the titular Nosferatu — here embodies not only fear, but also the inevitability of fate, the boundary between life and death, light and shadow.
